incidents.name: EquilibriaEPendle
incidents.notes: VaultEPendle did not update reward debt on share transfers and public getReward(account) let fresh receivers re-claim the same native rewards repeatedly.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0x615b0B54e585ab83ba1c94a734cd4499dEc1C956 to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0xd30d6fd662c0d92b49f3c3e478e125ba1d968059, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (58956036s -> 58768788s)
